title: Work Required to Pump Water from a Cylindrical Tank
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A cylindrical tank of radius 2 m and height 6 m is full of water (density 9800 N/m^3). Find the work required to pump all the water out over the top rim of the tank.

steps.title: Formulate Slice Volume and Weight
steps.mathExpression: \Delta V = \pi r^2 \Delta y = 4\pi \Delta y; \quad \Delta F = 9800 (4\pi \Delta y) = 39200\pi \Delta y
steps.explanation: A horizontal slice at height y has area 4pi and thickness dy.

steps.title: Identify Lifting Distance
steps.explanation: A slice at height y must be lifted to the top rim at y = 6.

steps.title: Integrate Work from y = 0 to y = 6
